title: Creation of Ravenscroft Asylum
text: The Ravenscroft Asylum is founded by Count Silas Ravencroft in Crescent Keep, overlooking the town of Crescent Hills.

title: Construction of Castle Hemmeth Begins
text: The visionary architect Norex Volcron begins the massive architectural undertaking of building the castle of King Hemmeth I.

title: Construction of Castle Hemmeth Finished
text: Norex Volcron completes the construction of Castle Hemmeth, plunging the country into massive debt to the Volcron family.

title: Castlefall & Fall of Hemmeth Empire
text: King Hemmeth I's Castle is mysteriously swallowed by unknown forces, killing the king and collapsing his empire.

title: The Fire of Crescent Keep
text: Crescent Keep is entirely destroyed by a catastrophic fire. King Hammeth II, Count Silas Ravencroft, and all staff and patients perish.

title: Collapse of the Hemmeth Succession
text: Following the sudden death of King Hemmeth II without a clear heir to the throne, the historic Hemmeth Empire officially collapses, plunging the entire country into a dark period of deep political unrest and instability, leading to a civil war.

title: Independence of Crescent Hills
text: Following the sudden collapse of the Hemmeth Empire, the town of Crescent Hills gains unique autonomous independence.

title: Creation of the Anchor Corporation
text: The Anchor Corporation is founded, quickly establishing a shipping powerhouse and seizing control of the Harbour District.

title: Coronation of King Alexander Algar
text: King Alexander Algar 'the Immortal' is officially crowned, shifting the political alignments of the kingdom, and ending the long civil war.

title: Siege of Crescent Hills
text: King Alexander conducts a successful military siege of Crescent Hills, forcefully absorbing the prosperous city into the new Algaros kingdom.

title: The Burial of Nikoleta Crowe
text: Nikoleta Angela Crowe is buried at the age of 18. Her family publicly claims that she is deceased.

title: Arrival of Laughingmen Entertainment
text: Laughingmen Entertainment makes its dramatic debut in Crescent Hills, building an expansive presence outside town borders.

title: Reappearance of Nikoleta Crowe
text: Nikoleta Crowe dramatically resurfaces as the bright and joyful co-owner of Laughingmen Entertainment, despite family claims of her death.

title: Creation of the People's Church
text: Arthur Marrow spearheads the People's Church of the Perfect Body, gathering rapid following inside the city.

title: The Burning of Carsteen Street
text: The city guard sets fire to the church chapel on Carsteen Street under smuggling allegations, burning down a massive portion of uptown.

title: The Murder of Mayor Zachery Marigold
text: Mayor Zachery Marigold of Eagle's Hope mysteriously dies after receiving a prophetic warning message from Evan Glass.

title: The Tower (Session 0)
text: On the eve of the anniversary, time stops via the Sandwalker effect. A group of anomalies meets Evan Glass and destroys the clocktower, tearing the ground open.

title: The Black Cloak Perimeter
text: The Order of the Black Cloak swoops into the farmlands of Eagle's Hope, setting up heavily armed perimeter checkpoints to contain the abyss.

title: The Chariot (Session 1)
text: The anomalies descend into the newly formed chasm, braving Volcron infrastructure, automated trains, and organic horrors to rescue Tyler the Flesh Harp.

title: Royal Commendation for Dr. Thalia Veil
text: King Alexander's Council formally decides to honor Black Cloak agent Dr. Thalia Veil, issuing a prestigious reward for her exceptional bravery and medical expertise demonstrated during the subterranean rescue of Tyler the Harp.

title: A Fire in the Hills (Session 1)
text: A mysterious man in a fedora rots the farmlands, sparking a devastating fire in the Hill District. Amidst city-wide chaos and looting, a newly formed crew clashes over a house robbery, gets arrested, and cuts a deal with investigator Medio Gato.

title: Operation Judgement (Session 2)
text: The expedition team advances into the copper restaurant layers of the castle. Head Forgemaster Roghar is discovered assassinated under suspicious gas line manipulation. The party recovers links to Fierre Laughingman before an ambush by the automaton 'Mstar Sun' claims the lives of Ninos and Dr. Thalia Veil.

title: Black Cloak Expedition Lockdown
text: Following the tragic deaths of Ninos and Dr. Thalia Veil during Operation Judgement, the Black Cloak Order issues an immediate lockdown on all exploration under or in Eagle's Hope. Both Operation Empress and Operation Star are placed on hold indefinitely, and all external contract members are ordered to remain at their current surface stations under threat of immediate termination.
